questions.analysis_html: \text{原式} = \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{10^{2x} \cdot 2\ln{10} + 7^{-x}\ln{7}}{2\sec^{2}{x} - \frac{1}{1 + x^{2}}} = 2\ln{10} + \ln{7}

questions.prompt_html: \lim_{x \to 1} \frac{(x^{3x-2}-x)\sin 2(x-1)}{(x-1)^{3}} = ()
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}& \text{原式} = 2 \lim_{x \rightarrow 1} \frac{\sin 2(x-1)}{2(x-1)} \frac{x^{3x-2}}{(x-1)^2} - x = 2 \lim_{x \rightarrow 1} \frac{x^{3x-2}}{(x-1)^2} - x \\& = 2 \lim_{x \rightarrow 1} \frac{(1+(x-1))^{3(x-1)+1} - (1+(x-1))}{(x-1)^2} = 2 \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{((1+x)^{3x}+1)(1+x)}{x^2} \\& = 2 \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{((1+x)^{3x}+1)}{x^2} = \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{(1+x)^{3x}(3 \ln(1+x)+\frac{3x}{1+x})}{x} \\& = \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} [(1+x)^{3x}(3 \ln(1+x)+\frac{3x}{1+x})^2 + (1+x)^{3x} \frac{3(x+2)}{(1+x)^2}] \\& = 3 + 3 = 6\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} [ 1 - \ln ( 1 + x ^ { 3 } ) ] ^ { \frac { 3 } { x ^ { 2 } \arcsin x } } = \ \ ( ) 。
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}[1-\ln(1+x^3)]^{\frac{3}{x^3\arcsin x}}=\exp\{\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{3}{x^2\arcsin x}\ln[1-\ln(1+x^3)]\}\\&=\exp[-\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{3}{x^3}\ln(1+x^3)]=\exp[-\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{3}{x^3}x^3]=e^{-3}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{cases} \dfrac{1}{x}(e^{4x}-e^{x}), x<0 \\ \text{若使}f(x)\text{处处可导，则常数}a\text{与}b\text{的值为}() \\ ax+b\cos x, x\geq 0 \end{cases}

options.label: A
options.html: \texttt{a = 7, b = 1 \ ; }

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} & \text{要使} f(x) \text{处处可导，首先须} f(x) \text{在} x=0 \text{连续，即} \\ & \lim_{x \rightarrow 0^{-}} f(x) = \lim_{x \rightarrow 0^{+}} f(x) = f(0) = b \\ & \text{即} b = \lim_{x \rightarrow 0^{-}} f(x) = \lim_{x \rightarrow 0^{+}} \frac{e^{4x}-e^{x}}{x} = 3 \\ & f_{-}^{\prime}(0) = \lim_{x \rightarrow 0^{-}} \frac{\frac{1}{x}(e^{4x}-e^{x})-3}{x} = \frac{15}{2} \\ & f_{+}^{\prime}(0) = \lim_{x \rightarrow 0^{+}} \frac{a x + 3 \cos x - 3}{x} = a \\ & \text{则} a = \frac{15}{2}, b = 3.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \lim_{x\to +\infty}\frac{\frac{\pi}{2}-\arctan{x}}{\frac{1}{x}} = \left( \right) .
questions.analysis_html: \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\frac{\pi}{2} - \arctan{x}}{\frac{1}{x}} = \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{-\frac{1}{1 + x^2}}{-\frac{1}{x^2}} = \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{x^2}{1 + x^2} = 1

questions.prompt_html: \lim_{x \rightarrow + \infty } ( \cos \frac { \pi } { \sqrt { x } } ) ^ { x } = \quad ( ) 。

options.label: C
options.html: e ^ { - \frac { x ^ { 2 } } { 2 } }

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x\rightarrow \infty}(\cos \frac{\pi}{\sqrt{x}})^{x}=\exp[\lim_{x\rightarrow \infty}x\ln(\cos \frac{\pi}{\sqrt{x}})]=\exp[\lim_{t\rightarrow 0^{+}}\frac{1}{t^{2}}(\cos \pi\,t-1)]\\&=\exp[\lim_{t\rightarrow 0^{+}}\frac{-\pi\sin \pi t}{2t}]=\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{\pi^{2}}{2}}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} ( \frac{ \arctan x } { x } ) ^ { \frac { 1 } { x ^ { 2 } } } = \ \ ( ) 。
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}(\frac{\arctan x}{x})^{\frac{1}{x^2}}=\exp[\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{1}{x^2}\ln(\frac{\arctan x}{x})]=\exp[\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{1}{x^2}\frac{(\arctan x-x)}{x}]\\&=\exp(\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{\frac{1}{1+x^2}-1}{3x^2})=\exp(\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{-x^2}{\frac{1+x^2}{3x^2}})=e^{-\frac{1}{3}}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \lim_{x \to 0} (2 \sin x + \cos x)^{ \frac{1}{x}} = \ \ ( ) 。
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}(2\sin x+\cos x)^{\frac{1}{x}}=\exp[\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{1}{x}\ln(2\sin x+\cos x)]\\&=\exp[\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{1}{x}(2\sin x+\cos x-1)]=\exp[\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{1}{1}(2\cos x-\sin x)]=e^{2}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{2}} \left( x - \frac{\pi}{2} \right) \cot 2x = ( ) \ .

options.label: A
options.html: \text{不存在};

questions.analysis_html: \text{原式} = \lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{x - \frac{\pi}{2}}{\tan 2x} = \lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{1}{2 \sec^22x} = \frac{1}{2}.

questions.prompt_html: \lim_{x \rightarrow + \infty} (x \tan \frac{1}{x})^{x^{2}} = \quad() 。
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x\rightarrow \infty}(x\tan\frac{1}{x})^{x^2}=\exp[\lim_{x\rightarrow \infty}x^2\ln(x\tan\frac{1}{x})]=\exp[\lim_{x\rightarrow \infty}x^2(x\tan\frac{1}{x}-1)]\\&=\exp[\lim_{t\rightarrow 0^+}\frac{1}{t^2}(\frac{\tan t-t}{t})]=\exp[\lim_{t\rightarrow 0^+}\frac{\sec^2 t-1}{3t^2}]=e^{\frac{1}{3}}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x(e^{x}+1)-2(e^{x}-1)}{\tan^{3} x} = \ \ ( ) 。
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{x(e^x+1)-2(e^x-1)}{\tan^3 x} = \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{x(e^x+1)-2(e^x-1)}{x^3} \\&= \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{e^x+1+xe^x-2e^x}{3x^2} = \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{1+xe^x-e^x}{3x^2} = \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{e^x+xe^x-e^x}{6x} = \frac{1}{6}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \lim_{x \rightarrow 2} \frac{2x^{2}-2^{x+1}}{\ln(3-x)}=()
questions.analysis_html: \text{原式} = \lim_{x \to 2} \frac{4x-2^{x+1}\ln{2}}{\frac{-1}{3-x}} = 8\ln{2}-8.

questions.prompt_html: \lim_{x \to 0} (\cot x - \frac{1}{x}) = ()
questions.analysis_html: \text{原式} = \lim_{x \to 0} \frac {x \cos x - \sin x } {x \sin x } = \lim_{x \to 0} \frac {x \cos x - \sin x } {x ^ {2}} = \lim_{x \to 0} \frac { - x \sin x } { 2 x } = 0

questions.prompt_html: \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{e^{2x}-e^{-x}-3x}{1-\cos x}=\left(\right)
questions.analysis_html: \text{原式} = \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2e^{2x} + e^{-x} - 3}{\sin x} = \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{4e^{2x} - e^{-x}}{\cos x} = 3.

questions.prompt_html: \lim_{x \to 0} ( \frac{ \sin x}{x} ) ^ { \frac { 1 } { x } } = \quad ( ) 。
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}(\frac{\sin x}{x})^{\frac{1}{x^{2}}}=\exp[\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{1}{x^{2}}\ln(\frac{\sin x}{x})]=\exp[\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{1}{x^{2}}\frac{(\sin x-x)}{x}]\\&=\exp(\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{\cos x-1}{3x^{2}})=e^{-\frac{1}{6}}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \lim_{x \rightarrow 2 \pi} \frac{ \ln \cos x } { 3 ^ { \sin x } - 1 } = \quad ( ) 。
questions.analysis_html: \lim_{x \to 2 \pi} \frac{ \ln \cos x }{ 3^{\sin x} - 1 } = \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{ \ln \cos t }{ 3^{\sin t} - 1 } = \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{ - \sin t }{ \cos t } \frac{ 1 }{ 3^{\sin t } \cos t \ln 3 } = 0
